title: A diary of impressions of new releases
description: Notes, discussion and whatever listening history is available, gathered around the album you choose.

blocks.text: For a fan community an album release can be a shared event. The review values the interaction and the stats, but states no request for personal listening goals. It is worth starting with discussion of the release and finding out which totals people actually want to keep.

quote.text: I like the interaction with people and getting into comeback seasons. But for days now, the app is really glitchy and won’t load my stats page. That’s the only negative.

blocks.text: Let people mark the recordings they love, keep their impressions and share the notes they choose. Show the connected service’s history separately from the user’s own marks.
Do not promise influence on the official charts and do not encourage artificial plays. An incomplete history must not look like an exact official counter.
